steps.content: The prickle of hostile intent triggers your combat instincts. Without hesitation, you lift both your hands, aiming them at the air—

Release what exactly? You have a nagging feeling that something red and sharp should emerge from your palms, but nothing happens. As you stand there, hands outstretched, the cold, unfamiliar presence creeps closer, crawling up your spine and lingering at the nape of your neck.
Are you trying to play hide and seek with me? Well, I've caught you.
I've won. As my reward... please forgive me for leaving your side.
The presence draws closer to you, yet maintains a delicate distance as if afraid you might break. A pair of bloodless hands gently encircle you, cradling you protectively in their embrace.

You must have been anxious when you opened your eyes and I wasn't there. I'm sorry—I was just taking some time to prepare myself. It's such an important day, and I wanted to look my absolute best for you.
Now that you're awake, let's begin our ceremony right away. I've been waiting for this day for so long... Finally, I have a wedding of my own.
She greedily breathes in your scent at the nape of your neck. Her ice-cold fingertips trail from your neck to your shoulders, down your arms... and farther along your body.
Finally, as her hands wander to more intimate parts of your body, you can't help but break your silence.

options: I don't think that's appropriate, miss.

steps.content: I thought our fated connection would make you instantly recognize the tight bond between us!

You understand every word she speaks, but the sentence they form leaves you completely baffled. The woman in the white wedding gown cups your face in her hands, then sighs with a mix of indulgence and resignation.

That's all right. I can wait as long as it takes... until our hair turns silver, until the roses wither, and the moonlight fades. I'll wait until you can accept what's in front of you—accept that we're destined to be together.
